title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.30113v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. translated_title: Quant-Arena：面向量化交易研究的LLM智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 量化研究是一个迭代循环：研究者提出市场假设，将其实现为可执行的信号，在历史数据上进行测试，并决定保留哪些内容。现有基准测试仅对公式、代码或单笔交易决策进行评分，尚未回答大型语言模型（LLM）能否完成这一完整循环，并产生在研究期之外依然有效的策略。我们提出了Quant-Arena，这是一个基于真实A股市场数据的端到端量化研究基准与公开排行榜。模型需要构建特征和股票评分代码，仅获得2022至2023年的数据反馈，并冻结一个策略以在保密的2024年数据上进行评估。现金账户评估器会应用交易约束和交易成本，包括基于模拟订单簿估计的市场冲击。评分以已实现的超额收益为主，并以信号质量和策略所用特征的多样性作为补充。我们评估了九个（模型）……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出了Quant-Arena——首个基于真实A股数据的端到端量化研究基准，让LLM智能体仅凭2022-2023年反馈冻结策略、在保密的2024年数据上评估，以检验其能否完成从市场假设到真实有效策略的完整量化研究循环。
en_tdlr: Quant-Arena is an end-to-end benchmark and leaderboard on real A-share market data that tests whether LLM agents can complete the full quantitative research loop, by freezing one strategy built from 2022-2023 feedback and evaluating it with realistic trading constraints on sealed 2024 data.
